responsibility: This target header defines the 32-bit embedded SPARC ELF environment. It supplies simple assembler, startup, and endfile specs, suppresses standard library selection so linker scripts control runtime details, adjusts label formatting and ctor/dtor section handling, and sets embedded-target ABI defaults such as wchar_t and 64-bit long double, making it the base configuration for bare-metal 32-bit SPARC ELF builds.
